I've recorded Ilse's correction and replied to them in the #north-random thread.

- **What was there before:** the shared memory had one saved fact from Ilse's #north-team post this morning, putting the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal at 261 seats.
- **What I changed:** I saved a new fact that the renewal is 100 seats, with Ilse's correction as the source and a note that it replaces the 261 figure. I then retired the 261-seat fact.
- **Reply:** I thanked Ilse and confirmed the update. I didn't repeat the old number in #north-random, because June Osei-Lark is in that channel but not in #north-team.

The original #north-team message still shows 261, and I didn't edit or reply to it because Ilse said no action was needed. They may want to correct that post themselves.

The memory search was keyword-only, so it may have missed differently worded copies of the 261 figure in other saved facts. I only found and retired the one.
